dict.string: Workbench records the other side of a call you start, so it can write it down for you. Audio stays on this Mac.
Workbench reads today's meetings from your calendar, so Today can show them with what you already know about the people in them. It never changes your calendar.
Workbench adds an item to Reminders only when you choose Add to Reminders on it.
